flows.settingsDesc: Configure the port, decryption, recorded traffic, and terminal environment.
flows.httpVersionDesc: The change applies to new connections.

flows.resetRecordedDataDesc: All traffic and its encryption keys will be deleted.

flows.newConnectionsDecrypted: New connections will be decrypted, except for excluded hosts and apps.
